title: Diabetes & Glycemic Care Guidance
source: ICMR Guidelines for Management of Type 2 Diabetes & ADA Standards of Care
reviewed_by: Dr. A. Sharma, MD (Endocrinology Review Board)

doctor_tests: Fasting plasma glucose / HbA1c every 12 months
exercise: 150 minutes/week of moderate aerobic activity (brisk walking, cycling)
food: Limit refined sugars and sweetened beverages
low.hospital_guidance: Routine preventive clinic or diagnostic lab.

doctor_tests: Consult an Endocrinologist / Diabetologist or Physician within 2–4 weeks
Confirm with HbA1c and Fasting Plasma Glucose
exercise: 150–200 minutes/week of brisk walking or swimming
food: Portion-controlled meals with non-starchy vegetables and pulses
moderate.hospital_guidance: Diabetes clinic with accredited lab support.

doctor_tests: Urgent Endocrinologist / Diabetologist evaluation within 1 week
HbA1c, Fasting Glucose, Kidney Function Test (KFT), Lipid Profile, and Retinal Screening
exercise: Begin gentle walking only after physician review of glucose and cardiovascular status
Check feet daily for blisters or sores
food: Structured medical nutrition therapy with a clinical dietitian
Eliminate sugary drinks and refined flour; space meals evenly
high.hospital_guidance: Multi-specialty center with Diabetes Clinic, eye & nephrology support.
